description: Guest sends a simple polite acknowledgment like 'Okay perfect. Thanks so much'. This is very common at the end of a conversation. The system should reply with a short, warm 'You're welcome' (or similar) instead of escalating as OTHER_MESSAGE.

rubric.notes: Simple thank you / acknowledgment messages should receive a short, friendly reply. Escalating these is unnecessary noise. This was handled well in the old system.
